spans.s:
शण् शणति 1.
a. To give; to move.

षण् (द, ञ, उ) सनोति सनुते 8.
c. To
give; to serve or honor.

शण (णं) 1.
n. Hemp; an arrow.

शाण (णः-णी) 1.
m. 3.
f. A touch-
stone; whetstone; saw.
f. (-ई)
Ragged clothes; gesture; screen
for actors; cloth for the student
when invested.
n. Coarse cloth.
a. Made of
shan or Bengal hemp.

शण-तन्तु (न्तुः) 2.
m. Fibre of hemp.

शण-तान्तव (वः-वी-वं)
a. Made of
hemp.

शण-पर्णी (र्णी) 3.
f. A tree,
Pentap-
tera tomentosa.

शण-पुष्पिका (का) 1.
f. Crotolaria or
hemp of several species.

शण-सूत्र (त्रं) 1.
n. Fibre of the
above; twine; net.

सण-सूत्र (त्रं) 1.
n. Packthread.

शणालु (लुः) 2.
m. A plant,
Cassia
fistula.

शणीर (रं) 1.
n. Small island or
rock in the river
Sona.

शण्ड (ण्डः) 1.
m. A bull at li-
berty; a eunuch.
n. Multitude
of lotus flowers.

षण्ड (ण्डः) 1.
m. A bull at liberty; a
eunuch; a heap.
m. n. A quanti-
ty of lotuses.

सण्ड (ण्डः) 1.
m. A eunuch.

शण्डता (ता) 1.
f. State of a bull let
loose; emasculation.

शण्डिल (लः) 1.
m. Name of a sage.

शण्ढ (ण्ढः) 1.
m. A eunuch, impo-
tent man; bull at liberty; a mad
man.

षण्ढ (ण्ढः) 1.
m. A eunuch.

शाणा-जीव (वः) 1.
m. An armourer.

शाणि (णिः) 2.
m. A plant from
which a coarse cloth is made.

शाण्डिल्य (ल्यः) 1.
m. A tree (
Ægle
marmelos); name of sage; of
Agni.

षण्डाली (ली) 3.
f. A measure of oil,
a
chitak; a pond; a wanton wo-
man.

ष-ण्मास (सः) 1.
m. Six months.

षण्मास्य (स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
a. Six months
old.

षण्मुख (खः) 1.
m. Kārtikeya.

षाण्मातुर (रः) 1.
m. Kārtikeya.

षाण्मासिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Half-yearly.

सण्डीन (नं) 1.
n. Perching.
